notes: Bump circuitVersion whenever the compiled circuit (and so the vk) changes. Every consumer pins one version: the SDK release, the prover image, the deployed PviumIdentity contract. circuitHash is the `hash` of the nargo artifact the vk was generated from and sunspotCircuitHash that of the Noir beta.22 artifact the Sunspot keys were generated from: the prover refuses artifacts with any other hash. Recompiling the same source does not reproduce either (Nargo.toml pulls libraries from git without a lock), so a rebuilt artifact is a new circuit version with new keys, not a refresh.
